newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via six-day system repurchases.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via six-day system repurchases.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added temporary reserves to the banking system on Friday through six-day system repurchase agreements, a Fed spokeswoman confirmed.
Most analysts had expected the Fed to add reserves to the banking system but forecasts varied as to what kind of operation the open market desk would conduct.
James Glassman, senior economist at Chase Securities Inc., citing a small add need, had said the Fed could add reserves through six-day system repurchases.
